node.title: Re^8: Using a git filter to Cache HTML Resources Locally
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
This is news to me. Who is discouraging their use and why?

A few references I found that caused me to make that statement:

  • [https://www.paulirish.com/2010/the-protocol-relative-url/|The Protocol-relative URL]: "Update 2014.12.17: ... this technique is now an anti-pattern."
  • [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Protocol-relative_URL|for Wikipedia links]: "protocol relative links should no longer be used on Wikipedia"
  • [https://joonas.fi/2016/12/27/stop-using-protocol-relative-urls/|Stop using protocol-relative URLs]
  • [https://nickcraver.com/blog/2017/05/22/https-on-stack-overflow/#mistakes-protocol-relative-urls|Mistakes: Protocol-Relative URLs]
